explain: Rule 67 limits Gazetted 3rd class officers' tender approval power to under NRs 3 crore (30 million)[cite: 1].

q: 7. The minimum no. of parties for doing any contract/agreement should be
explain: A contract requires a minimum of two parties: the promisor and the promisee.

q: 8. *What are the essential components of a valid contract?
explain: A valid contract requires mutual agreement, voluntary consent, and the intent to create legal obligations.

q: 9. At present, in Nepal the types of contract normally followed in housing project to save the government taxes is
explain: In small-scale housing, owners often provide materials themselves and contract only for labor to reduce tax liability.

explain: According to Nepal's PPR, tender documents for projects up to 20 million (2 crore) cost 3,000 NRS.

explain: Earnest money (bid security) ensures the bidder is serious and will sign the contract if awarded.

q: 13. *Earnest money is a ......towards the execution of a publicly tender government contract .
explain: It is a temporary deposit held until the contract is awarded and performance security is provided.

q: 16. *The object of technical drawing is
explain: Drawings are essential for estimating costs, guiding construction, and procuring the correct materials.

explain: Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) or bid security is deposited along with the bid submission to prove the bidder's genuine intent to undertake the work.

q: 21. A muster roll is:
options: attendance sheet of temporary workers for remuneration
inventory list of equipment and list of people on the site
list of jobs the workers must do on site
several drawing sheets of site rolled in a bundle
explain: A muster roll is the attendance record of temporary/casual workers used to calculate their wages/remuneration.

q: 24. Petty contract is:
options: work entrusted to a contractor without any restrictions
contract wholly owned by a single staff
contract selected as the best one
a contract of small amount and volume to be fully handled by a staff
explain: A petty contract involves a small amount/volume of work that can be fully managed and handled by a single designated staff member.

q: 25. Amount required to be deposited by contractor while submitting tender is
explain: Earnest money is the amount a contractor deposits along with the tender submission as a guarantee of serious intent.

q: 26. The increase in price of materials during the construction is called

q: 27. The main criteria for the selection of any contractor to perform any work are
explain: Contractors are evaluated on their financial stability, technical skill, available machinery, and past performance.

q: 28. The document announcing to prospective bidders that the owner is ready to receive bids is called
explain: A 'notice to bidders' (or tender notice) is the document that announces the owner's readiness to receive bids from prospective bidders.

q: 29. *Which of the following column is left blank in bidding documentary by the employing agency ?
explain: The agency provides the quantities (BOQ); the contractor must provide the unit rates to create their bid.

q: 30. As per Public Procurement Act/Regulation minimum time required for tender notice is :
explain: For national competitive bidding in Nepal, the standard notice period is 45 days.

q: 31. *An agreement between two parties or more to do or not to do any work is known as :
explain: A contract is a legally binding agreement between parties to fulfill specific obligations.

q: 32. FIDIC is
explain: FIDIC stands for the International Federation of Consulting Engineers, known for its standard contract forms.

q: 33. *A written offer submitted by contractors to execute certain work at certain rates within a fixed time is called :
explain: A tender (or bid) is the formal written offer provided by a contractor.

q: 34. The amount provided in the estimate and bill of quantities for some specialized works to be done by the specialist firm, whose details are not known at the time of preparing estimates is called
explain: A provisional sum is an amount included in the estimate for specialized works whose exact scope/details are not known at estimate preparation time.

q: 35. *The document announcing to prospective bidders that the owner is ready to receive the bids is called :
explain: The 'Notice to Bidders' or 'Invitation to Bid' is the formal announcement for procurement.

q: 36. *Acquisition of land for any construction should be performed :
explain: The owner must have possession of the land before inviting contractors to bid to avoid delays and legal issues.

q: 37. *Which of the following is not bid document?

q: 38. A set of documents submitted by a contractor to a project office with a description of works or goods to be provided and the proposed price is known as
explain: A tender is the set of documents submitted by a contractor describing proposed works/goods and their prices.

q: 39. As per the financial regulation minimum time required for tender notice is for NCB contract:
explain: Financial regulations stipulate a minimum of 30 days for tender notice period for National Competitive Bidding (NCB) contracts.

q: 40. Consulting works worth more than 10 crore NRS should be procured on the basis of
options: International level request for EOI and RFP

explain: The amount deposited with tender submission is termed earnest money deposit, serving as a bid guarantee.

options: should not create the stage of quarreling
if any problem created, there should be mutualization for discussion
